entities.name: Message checking procedures
entities.description: Procedures for checking messages before applying other protocol procedures. These ensure only valid messages proceed to further processing.

entities.name: Error handling procedures
entities.description: Procedures for handling unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data. Provides recovery mechanisms and compatibility for future protocol extensions.

entities.name: Dedicated connection with error thresholds
entities.description: Condition where error handling requirements are only mandatory/recommended when certain error thresholds are not exceeded during a dedicated connection.

entities.name: Implementation dependent error handling
entities.description: Property indicating detailed error handling procedures in the network are implementation dependent and may vary between PLMNs.

entities.name: Mandatory error handling
entities.description: Property indicating networks must implement error handling procedures marked as mandatory (shall) and strongly recommended (should) for protocol extensions.

relations.description: Error handling procedures are applied as part of the overall message checking and processing flow.
Mandatory error handling requirements are conditional on error thresholds not being reached during a dedicated connection.
Error handling procedures have implementation-dependent aspects that can vary between PLMNs.
